headline: Chile 2025 built from the LIR (Global law, 2025-07-01) with SII unit values: monthly impuesto único with month-specific UTM, global complementario overlay with the IPC-adjusted credit; the cesantía ceiling moved from 131,8 to 131,9 UF on 1 February 2025; the art. 57 interest exemption is a 1-peso notch.
